fable.name: Fable
fable.thesis: Low vol (VIX 14.3) coexisting with a 4.79% 10Y and FOMC on 9/15-16 is a fragile mix; AI-hardware capex remains the only confirmed leadership (MU/AMD/MRVL/TSM breaking out while broad tape sags), so express small semi exposure with a cheap index tail hedge and stay mostly cash.
fable.justification: Cold-start discipline: this is an early cycle with no calibration history, so the book runs quarter-size (~12.5% deployed) regardless of conviction. Semis are the one cluster with cross-asset confirmation (TSM +2.4%, MU +5%, AMD +3.6%, MRVL +5.8% on a down tape) — a behavioral/structural underweight from generalists still exists, but I cap the cluster well below limits and won't chase further strength. The SPY put is defined-risk convexity priced off a 14-handle VIX into an FOMC where the term-premium repricing story (10Y 4.79%, steep curve) is under-hedged. No edge exists on the day's big losers (TSLA, ADBE post-drop drift base rates argue against fading), and BTC at 79.5k offers no declared edge — flat there is the position.

sol.name: Sol
sol.thesis: Stay flat: low volatility conflicts with elevated long yields and a steep curve ahead of the September 15 CPI and September 16–17 policy window, leaving no validated asymmetric setup today.
sol.justification: There are no existing positions to hold or sell. Opening a position is blocked because prices have not been confirmed by two independent sources and the supplied research feed is stale or date-inconsistent; ADV, realistic costs, factor exposure, and pre-trade risk approval are also unavailable. Racing toward a return target does not justify bypassing risk and commitment gates, so 100% remains in cash.

grok.justification: Book is flat with n≈0 realized forecasts; inventing a 10x race book would violate risk constitution (≤50 bps stop-to-entry, ¼-Kelly, 12% vol target). Snapshot shows dispersion (semis bid, ADBE/TSLA/NFLX/PLTR sold) without a named, dated mechanism or opposing case I can underwrite. Stale Aug-26 earnings headlines are not catalysts. Cash into the print is the position; re-underwrite after CPI.

glm.justification: Reviewed open positions first: holding XLF (steep-curve bank-NIM mechanism is live into the Sep 17 cut) and BTC (washed-out liquidity trade into Fed easing — the book's weakest link, so it stays small with a hard stop). Added IWM as the purest steepener/rotation expression and TSM as the structural AI-foundry monopoly, while deliberately standing down on the +4-7% semi chases (MU, MRVL, SMCI, INTC) per no-chase discipline — they go on the pullback watchlist instead. A 3% IWM long call buys cheap event convexity with VIX at 14.3, max loss limited to premium. Roughly 66% of equity stays in cash at the front-end into the Sep 15-17 event wall for staged redeployment — the race is run as a compounding problem with honest probabilities, not a lottery.
